skills.name: Impurity Absolution (浄穢)
skills.line: There is no impure darkness before the lantern.
skills.description: Miakashi casts out all darkness and attacks a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Karmic Reverberation (業回)
skills.line: Karmic sins cannot easily be atoned for.
skills.description:
When Miakashi receives damage from an enemy, she inflicts 1 Karmic Hindrance stack on them.
When a non-summoned ally other than herself receives single target damage, and if she not inflicted with a control effect, Miakashi has a 50% chance of taking 50% of the damage for the ally. Also restores her own HP and the HP the ally with lowest proportion of HP by 6% of her max HP.
;Karmic Hindrance (業障)
:
:'''Debuff, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack decreases ATK by 5%.

skills.name: Thought Rectification (正念)
skills.line: The lanterns shine when your mind is clear.
skills.description: With her body cleansed, her mind calmed, and the lanterns shining brightly, Miakashi chants a sutra to summon a Lamp of Enlightenment. While the Lamp of Enlightenment is present on the battlefield, it increases the DEF of all non-summoned allies by 20% and causes enemies with 3 Karmic Hindrance stacks to become Fettered. At the start of her next turn, she withdraws the Lamp of Enlightenment and removes all Karmic Hindrance stacks from enemies. ;Karmic Hindrance (業障) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack decreases ATK by 5%. ;Lamp of Enlightenment (明識灯) :Immune to debuffs and control effects. It inherits 45% of her HP and 100% of her DEF. While it is present on the battlefield, decreases Miakashi's SPD by 40. When withdrawn, grants 2 onibi. :''(Uses ally summon spot.)''

upgrades.text: When a Lamp of Enlightenment is conjured, also dispels 1 debuff or control effect from each ally.
When a Lamp of Enlightenment is conjured, number of debuffs or control effects dispelled from each ally increases to 2.
